subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should #88204 be split into separate core TUI/session, external WeChat routing, background-event isolation, and meaningful-activity sorting tracks, and which track should remain canonical here?
rationale: The remaining work crosses core runtime policy, an external channel plugin, session UI semantics, and background-event delivery behavior, so automation cannot safely choose one product boundary or fix shape.

options.title: Split Into Focused Tracks
options.body: Use #51028 for meaningful-activity ordering, open or link separate canonical items for TUI default routing, WeChat identity reconciliation, and background-event flood isolation, and keep this issue as the umbrella until that triage is complete.

options.title: Keep As One Umbrella
options.body: Retain this issue as the canonical tracker for all four problems, accepting slower review and implementation because each subproblem needs different owners and proof.

options.title: Close After Narrow Duplicates
options.body: Close this only after every subproblem is either linked to an open canonical issue or proven fixed on current main with source, history, and release/main-only provenance.

recommendation.title: Split Into Focused Tracks
recommendation.body: Use #51028 for meaningful-activity ordering, open or link separate canonical items for TUI default routing, WeChat identity reconciliation, and background-event flood isolation, and keep this issue as the umbrella until that triage is complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session, TUI, gateway, and cron history makes this the strongest available owner for deciding how to split the core-side work.
